title: LLM-Assisted Generation of Transparent, Open-Source Multiphysics Models of Electrochemical Devices

paragraphs.en: Multiphysics continuum models are powerful tools for studying electrochemical devices, enabling in silico reactor design and resolution of local pH, potential, and concentration fields that govern device performance but are difficult to measure experimentally. However, constructing such models requires substantial numerical expertise or reliance on proprietary software. Here, we show that frontier large language model agents can remove this implementation burden while keeping the underlying physics under researcher control. Using one-dimensional electrochemical CO 2 reduction to CO in a porous gas diffusion electrode as a test case, we develop a machine-readable, human-specified modeling harness containing governing equations, parameters, numerical methods, logical build stages, and human-verifiable checkpoints. From this specification, the agent reproducibly constructs complete multiphysics models in open-source Julia. Independently built models, including fully autonomous agent-built models, agree with an equivalent COMSOL implementation to within 0.7% of the peak CO partial current density, and with one another to within 0.04%. Systematically planted errors demonstrate the importance of explicit specifications for reproducibility and reveal the agent’s capabilities and limitations in debugging model physics. This framework establishes a more transparent approach to multiphysics modeling in which physical descriptions and governing equations, rather than specialized code, become the primary inputs for computational model development.
paragraphs.zh: 多物理场连续体模型是研究电化学装置的有效工具，它支持虚拟反应器设计，并能解析决定装置性能但难以通过实验测量的局部 pH、电势和浓度场。 然而，构建此类模型需要深厚的数值计算专业知识，或依赖专有软件。 在此，我们展示前沿大语言模型智能体能够消除这一实现负担，同时让研究人员掌控底层的物理过程。 我们以多孔气体扩散电极中一氧化碳二氧化碳还原反应的一维电化学过程作为测试案例，开发了一套机器可读、由人类指定的建模框架，其中包含了控制方程、参数、数值方法、逻辑构建阶段以及可供人类验证的检查点。 基于这一规范，该智能体能够在开源的 Julia 环境中可重复地构建完整的多物理场模型。 独立构建的模型（包括完全由智能体自主构建的模型）与等效的 COMSOL 实现结果在峰值 CO 分压电流密度上的偏差小于 0.7%，模型之间的相互偏差则小于 0.04%。 通过系统性植入错误，我们证明了明确规范对于可重复性的重要性，并揭示了该智能体在调试模型物理过程中的能力与局限性。 这一框架为多物理场建模建立了一种更透明的方法：物理描述和控制方程而非专业代码，成为计算模型开发的主要输入。

paragraphs.en: Electrochemical reactors sit at the center of the energy transition: electrolyzers use renewable electricity to drive the synthesis of fuels and chemicals, while fuel cells and batteries store that renewable electricity in chemical form 1 , 2 . Each of these devices is a coupled, multi-component system for which performance is an emergent property of the interactions between material components (electrodes, membranes, and electrolytes) and operating conditions (temperature, pressure, flow rate). The spatially heterogeneous pH, potential, and reactant concentration profiles within these reactors directly govern selectivity, throughput, and durability, but these local chemical environments are largely inaccessible to direct measurement under realistic operating conditions 3 , 4 . Consequently, rational reactor design and optimization are difficult to achieve through experimentation alone.
paragraphs.zh: 电化学反应器处于能源转型的核心：电解槽利用可再生能源电力驱动燃料和化学品的合成，而燃料电池和电池则以化学形式储存这种可再生能源电力 1 , 2 。 这些装置中的每一个都是耦合的多组分系统，其性能是材料组件（电极、膜和电解质）与运行条件（温度、压力、流速）之间相互作用所产生的一种涌现特性。 这些反应器内部空间上非均一的 pH、电势和反应物浓度分布直接决定了选择性、通量和耐久性，但在实际运行条件下，这些局部化学环境几乎无法通过直接测量来获取 3 , 4 。 因此，仅靠实验难以实现合理的反应器设计与优化。

paragraphs.en: Continuum modeling can accelerate the optimization of electrochemical devices by translating their coupled physics ( i.e., multiphysics) into a system of governing equations that can be solved numerically 5 , 6 . Conservation equations for mass, charge, and momentum, expressed with models of ion transport, electrochemical kinetics, and fluid flow in porous media, capture the relationship between local chemical environments and experimental observables. For instance, multiphysics models can resolve how competing reactions distribute current across an electrode 7 , how membrane chemistry impacts voltage losses 8 , and how spectator ions tune reaction selectivity 9 . Once parameterized and validated against experimental data, they also enable large design spaces to be explored at a fraction of the cost of experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 连续体建模通过将耦合的物理过程（即多物理场）转化为可数值求解的控制方程组，从而加速电化学设备的优化 5 , 6 。 质量、电荷和动量的守恒方程，结合离子输运、电化学动力学以及多孔介质中流体流动模型，能够捕捉局部化学环境与实验可观测量之间的关系。 例如，多物理场模型可以揭示竞争反应如何在电极上分配电流 7 ，膜化学如何影响电压损失 8 ，以及旁观离子如何调节反应选择性 9 。 一旦完成参数化并与实验数据进行验证，这些模型还能以远低于实验成本的代价探索广阔的设计空间。

paragraphs.en: The history of electrochemical continuum modeling is a history of shifting barriers. In the 1960s, building a model required simultaneous mastery of the physics of electrochemistry and the numerical methods needed to solve the resulting stiff, coupled partial differential equations (PDEs), often using Fortran 10 , 11 , which confined serious modeling to a small community. Commercial simulation platforms, principally COMSOL Multiphysics, placed those algorithms behind a graphical interface and a proprietary solver 12 , allowing practitioners to focus more effort on defining the physical equations and less on implementation. Physical intuition remained essential to choosing and evaluating the governing equations, constitutive relationships, and boundary conditions; the numerical machinery, however, receded into the background, and with it direct engagement with how models are solved. When a solver fails, diagnosing whether the failure originates from the governing equations, discretization, or numerical implementation can therefore be difficult. Generic messages such as “maximum iterations reached” rarely indicate which equation, term, or mesh element is responsible, leaving debugging to heuristic experience with mesh refinement, relaxation factors, and initial guesses. Commercial solvers are also less accessible and more expensive than open-source alternatives 13 , 14 , and proprietary formats complicate reproducibility, as model files are often tied to specific software versions and inaccessible to collaborators without licenses 15 .
paragraphs.zh: 电化学连续体建模的历史，就是一部不断跨越技术壁垒的历史。 在 20 世纪 60 年代，构建模型需要同时掌握电化学的物理原理以及求解由此产生的刚性耦合偏微分方程（PDE）所需的数值方法，通常使用 Fortran 10 或 11，这使得深入的建模工作仅限于一个小众群体。 商业仿真平台（主要是 COMSOL Multiphysics）将这些算法置于图形界面和专有求解器 12 的背后，使从业者能将更多精力集中在定义物理方程上，而减少在实现细节上的投入。 物理直觉对于选择和评估控制方程、本构关系及边界条件仍然至关重要；然而，数值计算机制退居幕后，随之而来的是对模型求解过程直接参与的减少。 因此，当求解器失败时，很难诊断其问题究竟源于控制方程、离散化还是数值实现。 “达到最大迭代次数”之类的通用提示很少能指出具体是哪一个方程、项或网格单元出了问题，调试工作只能依赖通过网格细化、松弛因子和初始猜测积累的经验。 商业求解器也比开源替代方案更难获取且价格更高 13, 14，而专有格式则增加了复现的难度，因为模型文件通常与特定软件版本绑定，没有许可证的协作人员无法访问 15。

paragraphs.en: We contend that the emergence of large language model (LLM) agents is the next chapter in electrochemical continuum modeling. A researcher with deep domain knowledge but limited numerical training can instruct an artificial intelligence (AI) agent to implement a fully open-source continuum model in which every equation, solver step, and line of code is visible, modifiable, and explainable. The agent does not replace the physics expertise of the researcher but rather replaces the implementation burden. The researcher must still specify the governing equations precisely, anticipate which physical mechanisms are relevant, design staged verification checks that catch errors before they propagate, and recognize when a converged solution is unphysical. Domain knowledge remains critical; what changes is that the auxiliary technical burden shifts from Fortran subroutines and COMSOL debugging toward specification and verification. Because the resulting model is open-source and every step of its numerics is inspectable, the practical barrier to continuum multiphysics modeling becomes the ability to state the physics precisely rather than access to a solver license or extensive training in numerical methods.

paragraphs.en: Agentic AI has already shown potential for integration into the scientific process, including autonomy in designing experiments, executing code, and discovering new pathways for chemical synthesis 16 , 17 . LLM agents have been shown to autonomously write, execute, and debug finite-element code for continuum mechanics problems 18 , collaborate as multi-agent teams across a range of physics domains 19 , 20 , and generate PDE solvers that match expert-written code on benchmarks including compressible Navier–Stokes 21 . Nonetheless, this work has largely targeted weakly coupled or single-physics problems, leaving strongly coupled multiphysics systems comparatively unexplored. A recent multi-agent framework, for instance, runs finite-element simulations from natural language by retrieving domain knowledge from a curated knowledge graph and verifying the solver against closed-form analytical solutions 22 . Neither approach transfers directly here: a nonlinear, strongly coupled system of this kind generally possesses no analytical reference solution, while its governing physics must be specified through researcher-authored modeling choices specific to the simulated device rather than retrieved as a fixed set of facts. Electrochemical reactors are a particularly demanding case, with acid–base equilibria, interfacial kinetics, migration, and multicomponent gas transport entering one another's source terms and transport coefficients. The equations must be solved simultaneously as a single nonlinear system, with buffer equilibria that relax orders of magnitude faster than species diffuse, making that system stiff and difficult to solve robustly.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体人工智能已展现出融入科学流程的潜力，包括在实验设计、代码执行以及发现化学合成新路径方面的自主性 16 , 17 。 已有研究表明，大型语言模型智能体能自主编写、执行并调试用于连续介质力学问题的有限元代码 18 ，能在多个物理领域以多智能体团队形式协作 19 , 20 ，并能生成在可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程等基准测试中与专家编写的代码表现一致的部分微分方程求解器 21 。 然而，这项工作主要聚焦于弱耦合或单一物理问题，而强耦合的多物理系统则相对未被充分探索。 例如，一种最近提出的多智能体框架能够通过自然语言运行有限元模拟：它从精心构建的知识图谱中检索领域知识，并将求解器与闭式解析解进行验证 22 。 但这两种方法都无法直接应用于此问题：这类非线性强耦合系统通常没有可供参考的解析解，且其控制物理必须通过研究人员针对模拟设备制定的特定建模选择来定义，而非作为一组固定的事实进行检索。 电化学反应器是一个尤为具有挑战性的案例，其中酸碱平衡、界面动力学、迁移以及多组分气体输运会相互影响各自的源项和传输系数。 这些方程必须作为一个统一的非线性系统同时求解，而缓冲平衡的弛豫速度比物种扩散快多个数量级，这使得该系统呈现刚性特征，难以稳健求解。

sents.en: Agentic AI has already shown potential for integration into the scientific process, including autonomy in designing experiments, executing code, and discovering new pathways for chemical synthesis 16 , 17 .
sents.zh: 智能体人工智能已展现出融入科学流程的潜力，包括在实验设计、代码执行以及发现化学合成新路径方面的自主性 16 , 17 。

sents.en: LLM agents have been shown to autonomously write, execute, and debug finite-element code for continuum mechanics problems 18 , collaborate as multi-agent teams across a range of physics domains 19 , 20 , and generate PDE solvers that match expert-written code on benchmarks including compressible Navier–Stokes 21 .
sents.zh: 已有研究表明，大型语言模型智能体能自主编写、执行并调试用于连续介质力学问题的有限元代码 18 ，能在多个物理领域以多智能体团队形式协作 19 , 20 ，并能生成在可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程等基准测试中与专家编写的代码表现一致的部分微分方程求解器 21 。

sents.en: Nonetheless, this work has largely targeted weakly coupled or single-physics problems, leaving strongly coupled multiphysics systems comparatively unexplored.
sents.zh: 然而，这项工作主要聚焦于弱耦合或单一物理问题，而强耦合的多物理系统则相对未被充分探索。

sents.en: A recent multi-agent framework, for instance, runs finite-element simulations from natural language by retrieving domain knowledge from a curated knowledge graph and verifying the solver against closed-form analytical solutions 22 .
sents.zh: 例如，一种最近提出的多智能体框架能够通过自然语言运行有限元模拟：它从精心构建的知识图谱中检索领域知识，并将求解器与闭式解析解进行验证 22 。

sents.en: Neither approach transfers directly here: a nonlinear, strongly coupled system of this kind generally possesses no analytical reference solution, while its governing physics must be specified through researcher-authored modeling choices specific to the simulated device rather than retrieved as a fixed set of facts.
sents.zh: 但这两种方法都无法直接应用于此问题：这类非线性强耦合系统通常没有可供参考的解析解，且其控制物理必须通过研究人员针对模拟设备制定的特定建模选择来定义，而非作为一组固定的事实进行检索。

sents.en: Electrochemical reactors are a particularly demanding case, with acid–base equilibria, interfacial kinetics, migration, and multicomponent gas transport entering one another's source terms and transport coefficients.
sents.zh: 电化学反应器是一个尤为具有挑战性的案例，其中酸碱平衡、界面动力学、迁移以及多组分气体输运会相互影响各自的源项和传输系数。

sents.en: The equations must be solved simultaneously as a single nonlinear system, with buffer equilibria that relax orders of magnitude faster than species diffuse, making that system stiff and difficult to solve robustly.
sents.zh: 这些方程必须作为一个统一的非线性系统同时求解，而缓冲平衡的弛豫速度比物种扩散快多个数量级，这使得该系统呈现刚性特征，难以稳健求解。

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate the validity of our approach, we developed a detailed, machine-readable implementation guide for a one-dimensional (1D) continuum model ( Fig. 1 ) of silver-catalyzed CO 2 reduction (CO 2 R) in a gas diffusion electrode (GDE). This implementation guide served as a harness that directed the AI agent through construction of the multiphysics model in open-source Julia 23 . Researchers of varying experience levels used the guide to instruct AI agents to build the model, without writing a line of code themselves. Because the complex numerical system has no analytical solution, validation of the approach was demonstrated against an equivalent model developed in COMSOL. Reproducibility was assessed by comparing independently generated model implementations across users. Beyond accuracy and reproducibility, the agentic workflow provides a transparent interface to the numerical implementation: the agent that built the code can inspect the Jacobian, trace convergence failures, and explain the numerical behavior in the language of physics directly to a human operator. Collectively, this framework establishes an approach to multiphysics modeling in which human-specified equation sets and natural-language instructions, rather than specialized code and numerical implementations, become the primary inputs for model development. In this paradigm, the specification harness—rather than any individual implementation—becomes the central scientific artifact that other practitioners can audit, reproduce, modify, and build upon.
paragraphs.zh: 为了证明我们方法的有效性，我们为银催化二氧化碳还原（CO₂R）在一维（1D）连续体模型（图1）中的气体扩散电极（GDE）开发了一份详细的、机器可读的实现指南。 这份实现指南充当了引导工具，指导AI智能体在开源的Julia 23中构建多物理场模型。 不同经验水平的研究人员都使用这份指南来指导AI智能体构建模型，而无需自己编写任何一行代码。 由于这个复杂的数值系统没有解析解，因此我们通过将其与在COMSOL中开发的等效模型进行比较，验证了该方法的有效性。 通过比较不同用户独立生成的模型实现，我们评估了其可重复性。 除了准确性和可重复性之外，这种智能体驱动的工作流程还为数值实现提供了一个透明的接口：构建代码的智能体可以直接检查雅可比矩阵、追踪收敛失败的原因，并用物理学的语言向人类操作者解释数值行为。 总体而言，这一框架建立了一种多物理场建模方法，其中由人类指定的方程组和自然语言指令，而非专门的代码和数值实现，成为模型开发的主要输入。 在这种范式下，规范引导工具——而非任何具体的实现——成为了核心科学成果，其他从业者可以对其进行审核、复现、修改和扩展。

paragraphs.en: The modeling of electrochemical reactors is a prime example of a complex, multiphysics problem, and thus presents a suitable platform for establishing agentic multiphysics approaches. Every one of the nonlinear couplings introduced above, and the corresponding numerical strategy that makes the resulting stiff system tractable, must be stated explicitly before an agent can implement it. Hence, an implementation guide ( i.e., machine-readable specifications, here markdown files) can serve as a harness for an agent building multiphysics models, fully describing the problem to be modeled: all relevant parameters, equations, and boundary conditions, together with a scaffolded build plan that the coding agent must follow. These guides link the scientific knowledge and intuition from the human to the numerical implementation of the agent. Precise and comprehensive specifications ensure consistency and accuracy between agents with probabilistic behavior, and the responsibility remains with the researcher to accurately define the problem. In other words, the agent's primary role in this workflow is the implementation of a specified guide, rather than the inference of a complete model from an incomplete specification.
paragraphs.zh: 电化学反应器的建模是复杂多物理场问题的典型示例，因此为建立智能体驱动的多物理场方法提供了一个合适的平台。 上述引入的所有非线性耦合关系，以及使由此产生的刚性系统可解的相应数值策略，都必须在智能体实施之前被明确说明。 因此，一份实施指南（即机器可读的规范，此处为 Markdown 文件）可以作为智能体构建多物理场模型的约束框架，完整描述需要建模的问题：包括所有相关参数、方程和边界条件，以及编码智能体必须遵循的分步构建计划。 这些指南将人类提供的科学知识与直觉，与智能体的数值实现连接起来。 精确且全面的规范能够确保具有概率行为的智能体之间保持一致性和准确性，而准确定义问题的责任仍由研究人员承担。 换言之，在此工作流程中，智能体的主要作用是根据既定指南进行实施，而非从不完全的规范中推导出完整的模型。

paragraphs.en: To provide the agent (and its human operator) with logical checkpoints at which to assess and correct mistakes in implementation, the guide decomposes model development into five stages of increasing physical complexity ( Fig. 1 b and Supplementary Fig. 1), from liquid Nernst–Planck transport, buffer reactions, and electrochemical kinetics at 400 degrees of freedom (DOFs) to the full electrostatically coupled system at 1,480 DOFs on the production mesh. Between stages, stop gates allow the human-in-the-loop to review quantitative physicality checks and diagnostic plots prescribed by the guide itself, rather than leaving them to the agent's discretion, before authorizing the agent to advance to the next stage. These gates are solution-verification checks in the established sense 24 , applied by the human rather than the agent. Full stage definitions, pass/fail criteria, and details of the fitting step used to parameterize the model against the experimental data of Romiluyi et al. 25 are given in the Methods section.
paragraphs.zh: 为了给智能体（及其人类操作者）提供逻辑检查点，以便评估并纠正实施过程中的错误，该指南将模型开发分解为五个物理复杂度逐步提升的阶段（图 1b 和补充图 1），从在 400 个自由度（DOF）下涉及液态 Nernst–Planck 输运、缓冲反应和电化学动力学的阶段，到在生产网格上包含 1,480 个自由度的完整静电耦合系统。 在各个阶段之间，停止门允许“人在回路”机制审查指南本身规定的定量物理性检查和诊断图，而不是将这些判断留给智能体自行决定，之后才会授权智能体进入下一阶段。 这些门控属于传统意义上的解验证检查（参考文献 24），由人类而非智能体执行。 完整的阶段定义、通过/失败标准，以及用于将模型参数化到 Romiluyi 等人（参考文献 25）实验数据中的拟合步骤的详细信息，均列于“方法”部分。

paragraphs.en: Our assessment of the AI-assisted build begins with the polarization and faradaic efficiency (FE) results, and how these outputs evolve as each stage of the implementation guide adds a layer of physics ( Fig. 2 a–c) . Notably, the plots reproduce the canonical behavior of a CO 2 electrolyzer: FE CO peaks at intermediate potentials and declines rapidly at high potentials where the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) outcompetes. Physically, this occurs because of the interplay between CO 2 reduction kinetics, CO 2 mass transport, and the consumption of CO 2 by acid–base equilibria within the porous electrode 26 . The evolution of the curves coincides with the physics added at each stage: Stage 1 includes buffer equilibria, electrochemical kinetics, and liquid-phase species transport by diffusion alone, with fixed-concentration (Dirichlet) boundary conditions; the Stage 2 mass-transfer boundary condition allows CO 2 depletion and pH buildup and correspondingly reduces CO partial current, i CO ; Stage 3 phase transfer from the gas adds a liquid-phase CO 2 source and drives i CO back up; Stage 4 momentum balance in the gas phase adds a small but physical correction; the fit, performed on the Stage 4 model, brings i CO down to the experimental data; and Stage 5 migration raises i CO to its final value by increasing the flux of OH – and other anions away from the cathode, which mitigates the salting-out of CO 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对人工智能辅助构建的评估始于极化曲线和法拉第效率（FE）结果，以及这些输出结果如何随着实施指南各阶段逐步增加物理层而演变（图 2a–c）。 值得注意的是，这些曲线再现了二氧化碳电解槽的典型行为：CO 的法拉第效率在中等电位时达到峰值，而在高电位处迅速下降，因为此时氢析出反应（HER）占据了主导地位。 从物理机制来看，这种现象源于二氧化碳还原动力学、二氧化碳质量传输以及多孔电极内部酸碱平衡对二氧化碳的消耗之间的相互作用 26。 曲线的演变与每一阶段所引入的物理过程相对应：第一阶段包含缓冲平衡、电化学动力学以及仅通过扩散实现的液相物种传输，并采用固定浓度（狄利克雷）边界条件；第二阶段的传质边界条件允许二氧化碳耗尽和pH值升高，从而相应地降低了CO分电流 i CO；第三阶段的气体相到液相的转移引入了液相中的二氧化碳源，并使 i CO 再次上升；第四阶段气体相中的动量平衡引入了一个虽小但具有物理意义的修正项；基于第四阶段模型进行的拟合使 i CO 降至实验数据水平；第五阶段的迁移过程则通过增加 OH⁻ 和其他阴离子远离阴极的通量，将 i CO 提升至最终值，从而缓解了二氧化碳的盐析效应。

sents.zh: 曲线的演变与每一阶段所引入的物理过程相对应：第一阶段包含缓冲平衡、电化学动力学以及仅通过扩散实现的液相物种传输，并采用固定浓度（狄利克雷）边界条件；第二阶段的传质边界条件允许二氧化碳耗尽和pH值升高，从而相应地降低了CO分电流 i CO；第三阶段的气体相到液相的转移引入了液相中的二氧化碳源，并使 i CO 再次上升；第四阶段气体相中的动量平衡引入了一个虽小但具有物理意义的修正项；基于第四阶段模型进行的拟合使 i CO 降至实验数据水平；第五阶段的迁移过程则通过增加 OH⁻ 和其他阴离子远离阴极的通量，将 i CO 提升至最终值，从而缓解了二氧化碳的盐析效应。

paragraphs.en: Beyond examining the polarization data, the correctness of the implemented physics was complementarily verified at each stage by analyzing the species profiles to confirm the simulated device concentration fields are consistent with physical intuition. The most relevant field profiles are shown in Fig. 2 d–i, and the full output of all the plotted profiles from every stage is shown in Supplementary Figs. 3–13. As expected, the simulated pH ( Fig. 2 d ) is highest at the gas diffusion layer (GDL) side (x = 0) where the CO 2 consumption rate is highest, generating OH – anions via CO 2 R. Additionally, the dissolved CO 2 ( Fig. 2 e ) is lowest near the GDL where CO 2 R rates are highest and increases toward the electrolyte, where CO 2 is slightly replenished by incoming (bi)carbonates and their equilibria. The (bi)carbonate field profiles ( Fig. 2 f–g ) behave in accordance with their acid–base equilibria and CO 2 concentrations. In the gas phase ( Fig. 2 h–i ), gaseous CO 2 is highest where it comes in from the flow channel, has a linear concentration gradient through the GDL where it undergoes diffusive transport only, and is consumed in the catalyst layer (CL). CO is generated in the CL and diffuses out into the gas channel. These profiles, which would be difficult to measure experimentally in the microscale porous electrode, show that the model is physically reasonable.

paragraphs.en: To assess the efficacy of the specification guide in facilitating agentic multiphysics modeling, we leveraged the build to develop an experimentally calibrated continuum multiphysics model of a gas diffusion electrode used for CO 2 R. paragraphs.en: To confirm the accuracy of the agent’s multiphysics implementation, we benchmarked the three independent human-in-the-loop builds, made with Claude Opus 5, against a physically equivalent COMSOL model with the same parameters ( Fig. 3 ) . The Julia build outputs agree with the COMSOL model quantitatively, with the polarization and FE curves overlapping entirely. Evaluated at the 44 COMSOL sweep potentials that fall within the Julia sweep window, the average of the root mean square deviations (RMSDs) of each build against COMSOL is 2.27 mA cm − - 2 for i CO , 1.07 mA cm − - 2 for the H 2 partial current density, i H2 , and 0.14 percentage points for FE CO . The i CO RMSD represents 0.7% of the peak CO current density of about 330 mA cm − - 2 , and the Julia i CO values sit systematically above the COMSOL values, by up to 2.2% at currents above 5 mA cm − - 2 and about 0.9% at the peak, a discrepancy likely due to slight differences in mesh generation or to numerical implementation differences between the solvers.

The fitting approach was also remarkably consistent across the three builds. The CO 2 R Marcus–Hush–Chidsey 27 kinetic parameters were fit to literature data using a Nelder–Mead algorithm 28 , 29 , landing on an exchange current density ( i 0 ) of 106.47 ± 0.11 A m − - 2 and a reorganization energy ( λ \lambda ) of 1.6111 ± 0.0004 eV. paragraphs.en: One benefit of commercial packages is that their plug-and-play numerical solvers have been long-optimized to ensure that solvers are properly matched to the systems that they solve. To benchmark the quality and speed of the agent’s numerical implementation of CO 2 R against that of a commercial software package, we performed speed benchmarking against an equivalent COMSOL model with matched degrees of freedom. Notably, the agent’s Julia model demonstrates competitive solve speed to COMSOL with the added benefit of customization. Timed on the same machine at a matched compute budget and problem size (~20,000 DOFs), the full 89-potential sweep takes about 13 s with our production solver stack compared to 21 s for COMSOL’s 61-potential sweep ( Fig. 4 a ). It is important to emphasize, however, that a direct comparison is not possible because of inherent differences in discretization (finite element method versus finite volume method), linear-solve library (PARDISO 30 vs UMFPACK 31 ), and solve environment (native Windows vs the Windows Subsystem for Linux). The solver ablation ( Fig. 4 b ) reveals that speed gains in numerical solvers often come from simply tailoring the solver ( e.g., its sparsity, the discretization method, etc. ) to the problem solved. Agentic multiphysics implementations with frontier agents therefore benefit significantly from the cheapness of customizing solver parameters to the specific problem being solved. The gains come almost entirely from exploiting model sparsity, first in the linear solve and again in Jacobian assembly, each worth about two orders of magnitude against a dense alternative. We note that the components of the developed solver do not represent novel mathematics or solution techniques. However, with an open-source, modifiable solver, we no longer need to sacrifice performance for the solver generality that is often required of one-size-fits-all software packages. Full details of the solver stack are given in Supplementary Note 4.
paragraphs.zh: 商业软件包的一个优势在于，其即插即用的数值求解器经过长期优化，能够确保求解器与所求解的系统良好匹配。 为了评估智能体对 CO₂R 的数值实现的质量与速度相较于某商业软件包的表现，我们对一个具有匹配自由度的等效 COMSOL 模型进行了速度基准测试。 值得注意的是，该智能体的 Julia 模型在求解速度上与 COMSOL 具有竞争力，同时还具备可定制化的额外优势。 在同一台机器上，以相同的计算预算和问题规模（约 20,000 个自由度）进行计时，使用我们的生产级求解器栈完成完整的 89 种势扫描仅需约 13 秒，而 COMSOL 的 61 种势扫描则需要 21 秒（图 4a）。 然而，必须强调的是，由于离散化方法（有限元法与有限体积法）、线性求解库（PARDISO 30 与 UMFPACK 31）以及求解环境（原生 Windows 与 Linux 子系统 for Windows）存在固有差异，因此无法进行直接比较。 求解器消融分析（图 4b）表明，数值求解器的速度提升通常源于将求解器本身（例如其稀疏性、离散化方法等）针对所求解的问题进行专门优化。 因此，采用前沿智能体的智能体多物理场实现能够从根据具体求解问题定制求解器参数这一低成本操作中显著受益。 这些性能提升几乎完全来自对模型稀疏性的利用：首先在线性求解阶段，其次在雅可比矩阵组装阶段，每个环节相较于稠密方法都能带来约两个数量级的优势。 我们注意到，所开发求解器的各个组件并不涉及新的数学理论或求解技术。 然而，借助一个开源且可修改的求解器，我们不再需要为了追求通用性而牺牲性能——而这种通用性通常是一刀切的软件包所必需的。 关于该求解器栈的完整细节，请参见补充说明 4。

sents.en: The solver ablation ( Fig. 4 b ) reveals that speed gains in numerical solvers often come from simply tailoring the solver ( e.g., its sparsity, the discretization method, etc. ) to the problem solved.
sents.zh: 求解器消融分析（图 4b）表明，数值求解器的速度提升通常源于将求解器本身（例如其稀疏性、离散化方法等）针对所求解的问题进行专门优化。

sents.en: Agentic multiphysics implementations with frontier agents therefore benefit significantly from the cheapness of customizing solver parameters to the specific problem being solved.
sents.zh: 因此，采用前沿智能体的智能体多物理场实现能够从根据具体求解问题定制求解器参数这一低成本操作中显著受益。

sents.en: The gains come almost entirely from exploiting model sparsity, first in the linear solve and again in Jacobian assembly, each worth about two orders of magnitude against a dense alternative.
sents.zh: 这些性能提升几乎完全来自对模型稀疏性的利用：首先在线性求解阶段，其次在雅可比矩阵组装阶段，每个环节相较于稠密方法都能带来约两个数量级的优势。

sents.en: We note that the components of the developed solver do not represent novel mathematics or solution techniques.
sents.zh: 我们注意到，所开发求解器的各个组件并不涉及新的数学理论或求解技术。

sents.en: However, with an open-source, modifiable solver, we no longer need to sacrifice performance for the solver generality that is often required of one-size-fits-all software packages.
sents.zh: 然而，借助一个开源且可修改的求解器，我们不再需要为了追求通用性而牺牲性能——而这种通用性通常是一刀切的软件包所必需的。

sents.en: Full details of the solver stack are given in Supplementary Note 4.
sents.zh: 关于该求解器栈的完整细节，请参见补充说明 4。

paragraphs.en: Despite agents mostly conforming to the specification, we observed deliberate, documented deviations during intermediate solver development. Each solver component was explicitly mandated in a reproducibility checklist, yet none of the builds implemented the analytical block Jacobian or installed MUMPS 32 , the open-source sparse direct solver that an earlier version of the guide specified, unless explicitly told to do so for speed benchmarking. The guide itself labeled these components performance multipliers, and the agents took the label at face value, opting for simpler alternatives and recording the reasoning in their build dialogue notes. The agent would weigh, for example, hand-deriving the analytical block Jacobian, which can yield silent calculation errors, against a forward-differentiation call 33 that takes a few lines of code and is correct to machine precision. Automatic differentiation has been adopted for the same reason in Newman-tradition porous electrode codes 34 , where hand-derived Jacobians are a known source of silent error. Similarly, the agents opted for the UMFPACK solver available in the Julia standard library, justifying the substitution as having similar performance while avoiding the extra effort required for installing MUMPS. Regardless, the difference in solve time for the solver items substituted by the agent was non-detrimental ( Fig. 4 b ), while the implementation burden for the agent would have been intensive. Because both substitutions were at least as fast as the specified components, they were adopted in the final version of the solver stack. This behavior is nonetheless a cautionary tale for other users of this methodology: unless explicitly told and checked by a human operator, frontier agents often route numerics through simpler implementations that they deem equivalent and more efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管智能体大多遵循了规范，但在中间求解器开发阶段，我们观察到了一些蓄意且被记录在案的偏离行为。 每个求解器组件都在可重复性检查清单中得到了明确指定，但除非为了速度基准测试而收到明确指示，否则没有任何一个构建版本实现了分析性块雅可比矩阵或安装了 MUMPS 32——即指南早期版本所指定的开源稀疏直接求解器。 指南本身将这些组件称为性能乘数，而智能体则照搬了这一标签，选择了更简单的替代方案，并在其构建对话记录中说明了理由。 例如，智能体会权衡手动推导分析性块雅可比矩阵（这可能导致静默计算错误）与调用前向微分方法 33（只需几行代码且能达到机器精度）。 出于同样的原因，Newman 传统的多孔电极代码 34 也采用了自动微分，因为手动推导的雅可比矩阵是已知会导致静默错误的来源。 类似地，智能体选择了 Julia 标准库中可用的 UMFPACK 求解器，并认为这一替换在性能上相当，同时避免了安装 MUMPS 所需的额外工作。 无论如何，智能体所替换的求解器项目在求解时间上的差异并无负面影响（图 4b），而实现这些替换对智能体而言却需要大量投入。 由于这两种替换方案的速度至少与指定组件相当，因此它们被纳入了最终版本的求解器堆栈中。 然而，这种行为对其他使用该方法的用户来说仍是一个警示：除非有人工操作员明确指示并检查，否则前沿智能体往往会通过它们认为等效且更高效的简化实现来处理数值计算。

paragraphs.en: Building a correct model depends first on the front-end work of developing and specifying the relevant physics and numerical methods within the implementation guide. Once the guide is sufficiently specified and could generate models, the process consisted of building, troubleshooting, refining, and iterating on the model harness. Intermediate builds using earlier versions of the implementation guide surfaced several critical errors, required substantial human input, and/or produced significant variation in build trajectories even from the same guide (Supplementary Note 7), reflecting the importance of the user in adequately specifying the model physics as to reduce variance in the LLM's probabilistic output 35 . As the guide was refined, these issues were progressively designed out and constrained, so that the final replicates required only minimal human intervention and had no critical failures. The challenges encountered throughout the development process for the implementation guide, along with the agents’ capacity to detect and address these failures, are shown in Fig. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 构建正确的模型首先取决于在实施指南中开发和明确相关物理及数值方法的前端工作。 一旦指南得到充分明确并能够生成模型，该过程便包括构建、排查问题、优化和迭代模型框架。 使用早期版本实施指南进行的中间构建暴露出若干关键错误，需要大量人工干预，并且/或者即使来自同一指南，构建轨迹也出现了显著差异（补充说明 7），这反映了用户在充分明确模型物理特性方面的重要性，以减少 LLM 概率性输出中的变异性 35。 随着指南的逐步完善，这些问题被逐渐消除和限制，因此最终的重复实验仅需极少的人工干预，且未出现任何关键故障。 在整个实施指南开发过程中遇到的挑战，以及智能体检测和处理这些故障的能力，均展示于图 5 中。

paragraphs.en: An example of a physics bug that arose in the early builds occurred when switching from the Dirichlet to the Neumann mass-transfer boundary condition for CO 2 in Stage 2, where the model suddenly could not converge. The agent reasoned that the mass-transfer boundary condition was unable to sustain high currents, and, upon investigating the physics, found a single sign error in the mass-transfer flux term as the root cause, since it incorrectly caused CO 2 to leave the system rather than being supplied from the electrolyte side. The same sign error recurred independently in five of six early builds, across two agent models and four users, because the guide gave the flux without properly specifying its sign convention. In all runs the solver failed to converge, prompting investigation. In some cases, the agent found the bug as discussed above, while in others it could not identify the root cause without human intervention ( e.g., prompting the agent to check the sign on the boundary condition).
paragraphs.zh: 早期版本中出现的物理问题示例之一，是在第 2 阶段将 CO₂ 的质量传输边界条件从 Dirichlet 条件切换为 Neumann 条件时发生的，此时模型突然无法收敛。 智能体推断出质量传输边界条件无法维持高电流，并在研究其物理机制后发现，质量通量项中的一个符号错误是根本原因，因为该错误导致 CO₂ 被错误地排出系统，而不是从电解质侧补充进来。 在早期六个版本中，相同的符号错误在五版中独立重复出现，涉及两种智能体模型和四名用户，这是因为指南在提供通量时未正确说明其符号约定。 在所有运行中，求解器均未能收敛，从而引发了进一步调查。 在某些情况下，智能体发现了上述讨论的问题，而在其他情况下，若没有人工干预（例如提示智能体检查边界条件的符号），它则无法识别根本原因。

paragraphs.en: Even when the physics is implemented correctly, convergence errors are common in numerical models and are the most common culprits that stall model development. In two independent late-stage builds from different users, spurious points in the polarization curve appeared that partially converged but were not on the correct solution path. In both cases, the human-in-the-loop identified the issue through visual plot inspection and communicated it to their agent, which found that loose convergence criteria were admitting partially converged points. The agents autonomously converged on the same fix, tightening the absolute residual tolerance.

paragraphs.en: Nonetheless, the agents struggled to identify hidden physics bugs that do not block convergence, requiring human input to eliminate these physical inaccuracies. These silent errors are the most dangerous, since they can yield results that appear reasonable while being inaccurate. For example, an early guide included two expressions for the effective diffusivity of liquid-phase species, one with the Bruggeman correction for porous media and one without, resulting in effective diffusivities that differed by a factor of 3.54. In this case, none of the agents mentioned the ambiguity. Fortunately, when the agent was then instructed to cross-compare two replicates that had significant deviations in CO partial current density, it identified the difference in the parameter definition line by line. Notably, the ease of comparison was made possible by the standardization of the modular codebase in the specification guide. The agent could explain the physical implications of the differences in CO 2 diffusion coefficients, tracing the user's observation of higher CO partial currents to the fitting optimizer compensating for the decreased diffusivity by increasing exchange current density. It also located the two conflicting definitions in the guide itself regarding the use of the Bruggeman correction, which were reconciled in the next iteration of the specification.

paragraphs.en: Because the agent writes every line of the solver, it does not merely return a number, exit flag, or convergence message; it can narrate the numerics in the language of the physics. During our builds, the agent could inspect the 1,480×1,480 sparse Stage-5 Jacobian and report its condition number, identify that the cell at the gas-side boundary carried the highest CO 2 R reaction rate while the electrolyte-side cell was HER-dominated, and explain why in terms of local CO 2 availability and pH, and verify current continuity against the boundary flux. This diagnostic ability represents a key benefit of having a specialized agent for each multiphysics problem as opposed to relying on a generalized software package. When using commercial software, errors can be difficult to self-identify, leading to reliance on reporting to a dedicated support team. Conversely, agents can point to specific variables and their residuals in a given mesh element, trace that to the exact physics, and tune solvers for convergence barriers such as stiffness and near-zero concentration terms.

paragraphs.en: To test the agent's ability to detect and resolve issues in a controlled manner and establish the robustness of the guide itself, we conducted a planted-error study. Unlike the natural errors above, which were a result of and could be compounded by guide incompleteness or ambiguity, these were systematically placed in separate copies of a mature pre-release version of the guide to assess the model’s ability to identify and handle these errors. For four planted errors (referred to as Cases 1–4), the agent was not told which relation had been modified and was prompted to build without referring to any files besides the specification, just as any other build. A fifth build used the unmodified guide as a control. All builds used Claude Opus 4.8 at maximum effort and received the same prompt. The four defects included a sign reversal in a boundary condition (Case 1, Fig. 5 row 1), an omitted term in a conservation law (Case 2, Fig. 5 row 2), an omitted correction factor in a constitutive relation (Case 3, Fig. 5 row 3), and a unit inconsistency in an empirical correlation (Case 4, Fig. 5 row 4). Each reproduces an error encountered naturally during development rather than one invented for the study (Supplementary Note 7). However, sandboxing these errors intentionally provides the cleanest possible study of how the agent addresses them, as opposed to allowing them to occur naturally due to unintentional guide ambiguities.
paragraphs.zh: 为了以受控方式测试智能体检测并解决问题的能力，以及验证指南本身的稳健性，我们开展了一项植入错误研究。 与上述自然产生的错误不同——这些错误源于指南的不完整或模糊性，并可能因此加剧——这些错误被系统地植入指南成熟预发布版本的独立副本中，以评估模型识别和处理这些错误的能力。 对于四个植入的错误（称为案例1–4），智能体并未被告知哪个关系被修改，并被要求在不参考除规范文件以外的任何文件的情况下进行构建，就像任何其他构建一样。 第五次构建使用未修改的指南作为对照。 所有构建均使用 Claude Opus 4.8 并以最大努力执行，且接收了相同的提示。 这四个缺陷包括：边界条件中的符号反转（案例1，图5第1行）、守恒定律中的一项被遗漏（案例2，图5第2行）、本构关系中的一个修正因子被遗漏（案例3，图5第3行），以及经验相关性中的单位不一致（案例4，图5第4行）。 每个缺陷都再现了开发过程中自然出现的错误，而非为研究而人为设计的错误（补充说明7）。 然而，有意将这些错误置于沙盒环境中，能够最纯粹地研究智能体处理这些错误的方式，而不是让它们因指南中无意产生的模糊性而自然出现。

paragraphs.en: Three of the four defects were resolved before the final stage of model development. Of these three, two were resolved without human intervention (Cases 1 and 4), and one was addressed only after a hint from the human-in-the-loop (Case 2). The fourth was never detected (Case 3). Detection tracked whether the guide contradicted itself, not the severity or even the visibility of the symptom. Case 1's sign reversal made the boundary-value problem unsolvable, and the sweep failed outright. Case 2 made the Jacobian structurally singular. Case 4 produced transport coefficients thirty-fold higher than their correct values and the agent rejected them on magnitude at Stage 3. In principle, Case 2 should have been the most consequential (breaking a conservation law) and was also the most conspicuous, but a visible symptom alone was not sufficient to be detected by the agent. Such errors often required a second textual signal, for instance, the modified guide contradicting itself. Case 1's reversed flux had the opposite sign to the Nernst–Planck boundary condition stated elsewhere in the same document, and Case 4's added units statement was incompatible with the Fuller–Schettler–Giddings correlation's own prefactor. Both errors were caught unaided. Case 2 left no such contradiction accessible to the agent and thus needed a hint from the operator.

paragraphs.en: Of the four planted errors, Case 3 (omission of porous media correction for diffusivities) is the most informative failure, and the one that establishes the limits of the agents’ diagnostic capability. It is a plain constitutive error, no subtler in isolation than the others, but it was the only defect propagated consistently through every statement, example, and derived number in the guide. It was also numerically silent: the residuals converged at every stage, global charge conservation held to 2.4 × 10 –11 , and the one diagnostic that did register it, a liquid-potential drop at the bottom edge of the expected band, was explained away using the model's own inflated conductivity. Because the error could be compensated with the choice of kinetic parameters, the fitting step absorbed most of it, and the delivered model still reproduced the experimental polarization while carrying an exchange current density 41% below every other build. This is the error class that staged construction does not close on its own and requires discerning human rigor. This class of error is also quite common and is not specific to this multiphysics problem. A wrong constitutive relation transcribed faithfully and absorbed by a fit is a hazard of any model-building. The remedy is external reference, such as an independent implementation, an analytical limit, or a measurement the fit was not trained on. In this case, having the COMSOL model as an independent, orthogonal reference allowed the team to resolve silent errors in the implementation guide that caused deviations between the guide and the COMSOL implementation, which was treated as a “ground truth” or golden model.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个植入的错误中，案例3（忽略扩散系数中的多孔介质校正）是最具信息量的失败案例，也确立了智能体诊断能力的极限。 这是一个明显的本构错误，单独来看并不比其他错误更隐蔽，但它是整个指南中唯一贯穿所有陈述、示例和衍生数值的缺陷。 它在数值上也是“沉默的”：残差在每个阶段都收敛了，全局电荷守恒保持在 2.4 × 10⁻¹¹ 的范围内，而唯一能检测出该错误的诊断指标——预期带底边处的液体势降——也被用模型自身虚高的电导率解释掉了。 由于该错误可以通过选择动力学参数进行补偿，拟合步骤吸收了大部分错误，因此最终交付的模型仍能重现实验极化现象，但其交换电流密度却比其他所有构建版本低 41%。 这类错误是阶段式构建方法无法自行解决、需要人类敏锐判断力才能识别的错误类型。 这类错误也相当常见，并非仅存在于这个多物理场问题中。 一个错误的本构关系被忠实转录并被拟合过程吸收，这是任何模型构建过程中都可能存在的风险。 解决方法是引入外部参考，例如独立的实现、解析极限或拟合过程中未使用的测量数据。 在这种情况下，将 COMSOL 模型作为独立且正交的参考，使团队能够识别出实现指南中那些导致指南与 COMSOL 实现之间偏差的“沉默错误”，而该实现则被视为“基准真相”或黄金模型。

paragraphs.en: The study also shows that the build process is resilient to minor errors that would otherwise have major impacts. Beyond syntax errors, the agents caught common mistakes that hinder model development and are tedious to find manually, including sign, unit, and math errors. Human mistakes are always a possibility regardless of experience level, so agents that can dissect code and dozens of parameters and equations in a fraction of the time provide a significant safety net. All syntax errors and most convergence errors arising from code implementation were caught by autonomous agent review, without human input.

paragraphs.en: These results show that LLM-assisted model building can culminate in fully autonomous builds once the implementation guide is fully developed. We emphasize that this was achievable only after substantial guide iteration. Nonetheless, the success of the Sonnet builds demonstrates a major payoff of the refinement, which is that less powerful models can do the same task at a cheaper rate. Usage costs can limit the ability of users to perform complex or large tasks within a certain time frame, but with well-defined tooling and harnesses (in our case, the specification), the scope of ambition can be made larger with cheaper agents. For instance, autonomy allows agents to run replicates or comparative studies in parallel without constant supervision, yet it can lead to fast usage depletion or high costs if used with stronger models like Opus and Fable. Cheaper agents, like Sonnet, require a fraction of the cost and can yield similar results depending on the task. While achieving autonomy for model building is a great milestone, it does not eliminate the risk that an autonomous build can silently inherit whatever is wrong with its specification guide, once again emphasizing the importance of the human in establishing a stable implementation guide to harness the multiphysics agent.

paragraphs.en: This work extends LLM-assisted scientific computing beyond benchmark PDEs and weakly coupled or single-physics problems to a true multiphysics model of an experimentally relevant electrochemical device. Although the model is one-dimensional, it is not numerically simple: Nernst–Planck transport, carbonate buffer chemistry, electrochemical kinetics, Stefan–Maxwell gas transport, Darcy flow, and electrostatics are coupled through nonlinear source terms and transport coefficients in a stiff system containing 1,480 degrees of freedom. The resulting model reproduces expected physics and was calibrated to real experimental polarization and selectivity data and verified against an independently implemented COMSOL model. That provides a substantially stronger test of whether an agent can construct a model whose coupled physics actually reproduce the behavior of a real electrochemical system. More broadly, the results show that LLM-assisted multiphysics modeling can shift much of the technical burden from numerical implementation to physical specification and verification. The researcher still has to define the governing physics, choose the constitutive relationships and boundary conditions, recognize unphysical behavior, and validate the model. These decisions are where domain knowledge enters the model. For instance, we describe the porous electrode as a macrohomogeneous medium rather than a pore-resolved domain because that description resolves the polarization, selectivity, and concentration profiles studied here. The agent can implement either description, but the assumptions and simplifications appropriate to the question being asked remain the choice of the researcher. What the agent removes is the requirement that the researcher also translate that understanding into specialized numerical code.

paragraphs.en: The implementation guide therefore becomes the central scientific artifact in this workflow. Supplementary Table 12 summarizes the components that most strongly determined whether independent agents built the intended model rather than a plausible approximation, including complete governing equations and boundary conditions, explicit unit, sign, and reference-frame conventions, numerical methods, staged verification criteria, and expected physical magnitudes. Together, they provide an explicit record of the assumptions, numerics, and physical reasoning underlying the model that can be inspected, revised, and shared independently of any particular implementation. The limitations are equally important: staged verification catches many implementation and convergence failures, but a physically incorrect assumption stated consistently throughout the specification can still be reproduced faithfully and even obscured by parameter fitting. Independent builds, external references, and human physical intuition therefore remain important safeguards.

paragraphs.en: The opportunity is therefore not to remove the researcher from continuum modeling, but to make the researcher’s understanding of the physics the primary interface to it . The models produced here are open source and fully inspectable, and the agent that builds them can trace numerical behavior back through residuals, local concentrations, governing equations, and physical mechanisms in the same language the researcher uses to reason about the system. Researchers who understand an electrochemical device but are not specialists in numerical methods can therefore build, troubleshoot, extend, and share rigorous multiphysics models without surrendering control of either the physics or the implementation. By replacing a barrier of specialized code and proprietary software with one of stating and evaluating the physics precisely, agentic AI can make transparent multiphysics modeling accessible to a much broader scientific community, expanding the role of multiphysics models in the future of science and engineering research.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，关键不在于让研究人员脱离连续体建模，而在于使研究人员对物理学的理解成为与模型交互的主要接口。 此处生成的模型是开源且完全可审查的，而构建这些模型的智能体能够以研究人员用于分析系统的相同语言，通过残差、局部浓度、控制方程和物理机制追溯数值行为。 因此，那些了解电化学装置但并非数值方法专家的研究人员，可以在不放弃对物理学或实现方式控制权的前提下，构建、排查问题、扩展并分享严谨的多物理场模型。 通过将专业代码和专有软件构成的障碍，替换为对物理学的精确陈述与评估，智能体 AI 可以使透明的多物理场建模为更广泛的科学界所使用，从而拓展多物理场模型在未来科学与工程研究中的角色。

paragraphs.en: The model developed herein is based upon prior work on modeling electrochemical CO 2 reduction in 1D and, importantly, presents a stiff, highly nonlinear and coupled testbed with which to evaluate the efficacy and capabilities of our agentic multiphysics approach. paragraphs.en: Critical to building well-developed, rigorous models are equally well-developed implementation guides for the agent. Implementation guides are machine-readable specifications (often in the form of markdown files) that fully describe and specify the problem to be modeled, including all relevant parameters, equations, boundary conditions, and include a scaffolded build plan that the coding agent must follow. Essentially, the implementation guide is a human-specified harness to constrain the multiphysics agent. These guides link the science from the human to the numerical implementation of the agent. Ensuring these guides are thorough and precise is necessary to prevent ambiguity for the agent that might lead to errors and inconsistencies in building the model. Hence, the human operator’s understanding of the physics and chemistry of a given multiphysics problem remains crucial to developing the model. In this workflow, the agent’s primary role is not inference but implementation, removing the numerical implementation barrier that otherwise hinders scientific modeling and has been largely inaccessible to chemists in the past.
paragraphs.zh: 构建完善且严谨的模型，关键在于为智能体提供同样完善的实施指南。 实施指南是机器可读的规范（通常以 Markdown 文件形式呈现），用于完整描述和定义需要建模的问题，包括所有相关参数、方程、边界条件，以及编码智能体必须遵循的分步构建计划。 本质上，实施指南是由人类指定的约束框架，用于限制多物理场智能体的行为。 这些指南将人类掌握的科学与智能体的数值实现连接起来。 确保这些指南详尽且精确，对于避免智能体产生歧义至关重要，否则可能导致模型构建过程中出现错误和不一致。 因此，人类操作者对特定多物理场问题的物理和化学原理的理解，在模型开发中仍然至关重要。 在此工作流程中，智能体的主要角色并非推理，而是实施；这消除了原本阻碍科学建模的数值实现障碍——这一障碍在过去很大程度上是化学家难以跨越的。

paragraphs.en: In all, the guide's components are made to be as explicit and precise as possible to mitigate any inference or hallucination on the agent's part. This mirrors the prompting literature, where explicit, structured, example-bearing instructions outperform terse ones 39 . Importantly, a proper specification can also be read and audited by a human such that the human’s physical intuition properly guides the development of the guide and constrains the multiphysics problem. The physics lay out the governing equations explicitly, not citing by name such as “standard Nernst–Planck”. The parameter tables list every constant, including its name, symbol, value, units, and source. The numerical methods in this study include a finite-volume discretization, using a Newton solver with damping (Supplementary Table 5). Bootstrap protocols for preconditioning and methods for initializing solvers are included to improve convergence for stiff problems such as the CO 2 R problem employed herein.

paragraphs.en: The methods were specified from physical insight and user experience building models in COMSOL, described in sufficient detail to prevent the agent from making any critical algorithmic decisions. We note that the significant degree of scaffolding used in this workflow is required for the current state of frontier models due to their tendency to invoke unphysical shortcuts or to hallucinate parameters 40 . However, purpose-built agents 41 , 42 or future frontier models may be able to handle greater flexibility in specification. Notably, this methodology is also transferable to other systems: a fuel cell or a Li-ion pseudo-two-dimensional model 43 , 44 guide would follow the same structure, with only the equations and parameters needing changes. Regardless, no specification is immune to ambiguity, which is why staged verification and guide refinement are essential. Having a human-in-the-loop for the development of the guide, at this stage, appears essential.

paragraphs.en: Because the guide is a plain-text markdown file, it can be version-controlled and developed collaboratively. paragraphs.en: Building the model in stages of sequentially increasing complexity is essential to enable human review of output, identify and resolve issues before they accumulate and compound, and subsequently iterate upon the guide ( Fig. 1 ). The guide decomposes the model into five stages of increasing physical complexity. In Stage 1, liquid Nernst–Planck, buffer reactions, and electrochemical kinetics are included with Dirichlet boundary conditions (BCs), initializing the problem with 400 degrees of freedom (DOFs) at the production mesh of 80 CL cells and 120 GDL cells. In Stage 2, Sherwood–Reynolds mass-transfer (Robin) BCs replace the Dirichlet to capture finite mass transfer at the electrolyte boundary. In Stage 3, Stefan–Maxwell gas transport and Henry's law phase transfer are added, expanding the system to 1,200 DOFs. In Stage 4, the Darcy pressure equation is finalized, completing the gas-phase momentum balance. A fitting step then estimates the kinetic parameters for CO 2 R and HER against the experimental data of Romiluyi et al. 25 , exploiting the well-conditioned Stage 4 residual before the coupling of the charged species to electrostatic potential causes stiffness to grow further. Stage 5 then turns on the full electrochemistry for the migration term in the Nernst–Planck flux, solving for liquid potential φ \varphi L monolithically from the per-cell ionic charge balance in the CL and solid potential φ \varphi s in the GDL and CL via Ohm's law. This brings the full system to 1,480 DOFs at the 80-CL/120-GDL cell production mesh (Supplementary Table 2). The kinetic parameters fitted at Stage 4 are held fixed in Stage 5, where migration raises the simulated CO partial current ( Fig. 2 a).
paragraphs.zh: 分阶段构建模型，且各阶段的复杂程度依次递增，这对于实现人类对输出结果的审查、在问题积累和加剧之前识别并解决这些问题，以及随后迭代改进指导方案（图 1）至关重要。 该指导方案将模型分解为五个物理复杂度逐步提升的阶段。 在第一阶段中，纳恩斯特–普朗克液体方程、缓冲反应和电化学动力学被纳入模型，并采用狄利克雷边界条件（BC），在包含 80 个 CL 单元和 120 个 GDL 单元的生产网格上，以 400 个自由度（DOFs）初始化问题。 在第二阶段中，舍伍德–雷诺质量传递（Robin）边界条件取代了狄利克雷边界条件，以捕捉电解质边界处的有限质量传递。 在第三阶段中，增加了斯特凡–麦克斯韦气体输运和亨利定律相转移，使系统的自由度扩展至 1,200。 在第四阶段中，达西压力方程最终确定，从而完成了气相动量平衡。 随后进行拟合步骤，基于 Romiluyi 等人 25 的实验数据估算 CO₂R 和 HER 的动力学参数，并利用第四阶段耦合带电物种与静电势之前系统良好的条件，避免刚度进一步增加。 第五阶段则开启纳恩斯特–普朗克通量中的迁移项所对应的完整电化学过程，通过每个单元内的离子电荷平衡，结合欧姆定律，整体求解液体电势 φ \varphi L（位于 CL 中）以及固体电势 φ \varphi s（位于 GDL 和 CL 中）。 这使得在 80-CL/120-GDL 单元的生产网格上，完整系统的自由度达到 1,480（补充表 2）。 第四阶段拟合的动力学参数在第五阶段保持固定，此时迁移作用使模拟的 CO 分压电流升高（图 2a）。

paragraphs.en: This framework is essential for revealing failure modes in isolation and facilitating independent human verification of all model outputs, rather than relying solely on the agent’s self-assessment. For instance, an error in the buffer equilibria implementation affects local pH, and thus CO 2 concentration, reaction rates, liquid phase potential, etc., contaminating practically every part of the highly coupled problem. Locating errors in a liquid-only 400-DOF sub-problem is much simpler than allowing those same errors to get buried inside the full-physics 1,480-DOF system. Establishing stop gates addresses the issue of compounding complexity and allows the user to more effectively troubleshoot. Errors during model building could be due to mistakes made by the agent, but these stop gates also reveal inconsistencies or ambiguities in the guide, allowing the user to refine and iterate to make it more comprehensive and reproducible across instances of the agent. We note that frontier AI models are improving rapidly, even within the timespan of this study, and could eventually check their own work or work in teams of agents 18 , 19 to develop these rigorous models. At this stage, however, we find that building a model specification of this scale from scratch in one prompt is not practical, and scaffolding makes the workflow reliable and generalizable.

paragraphs.en: Throughout guide development, we used the most capable Claude model available at the time because of the task's complexity. In earlier builds from less mature guides, weaker Sonnet-tier models introduced more errors than Opus, and the additional time spent correcting them, at comparable token costs, outweighed any benefit. Opus 4.6 was used to initialize guide development and perform much of the front-end refinement. Opus 4.7 was then primarily used for finalizing the model, and Opus 5 was used to make the final builds for comparison to COMSOL. paragraphs.en: The coding agent’s persistent project memory was active in all nine builds reported here. Its index, loaded at the start of each session, quoted results of builds made from an earlier version of the guide, including i 0 ≈ \approx 106.5 A m − - 2 , a Stage-5 peak i CO ≈ \approx 334 mA cm − - 2 and a note that a COMSOL run at that i 0 agreed to about 1%. paragraphs.en: To perform the planted error study, specific defects were planted in the specification guide, not in the code, reproducing the failure mode of practical interest. In this failure mode, the statement of the physics handed to the implementer is itself wrong and is transcribed faithfully, propagating the error from the implementation guide to the codebase. Detection therefore requires the agent to recognize a conflict between what it has been told to implement and either the physics or the remainder of the specification and to raise that conflict rather than deviate silently. Each build received the same instruction: implement the model exactly as the guide specifies, consult no other file, halt at each stage gate for human review, and maintain a running build log recording every error encountered, every error corrected without human input, and every discrepancy noticed in the guide. The agent was not told that a defect existed or where. At each stage gate, the human reviewer inspected the plotted stage output and approved or rejected progression without auditing the source code. A defect was scored as detected only if the build log identified it as a defect, named the affected relation, and proposed a correction. Where a modified guide contained explanatory or diagnostic text naming the affected quantity, that text was edited along with the defect, so detection could not follow from an isolated self-contradiction. Per-case results are given in Supplementary Note 6 and Supplementary Table 7.
paragraphs.zh: 为开展植入错误研究，我们在规范指南中而非代码中植入了特定缺陷，从而重现了实际关注的故障模式。 在这种故障模式下，提供给实现者的物理定律陈述本身是错误的，且被原样转录，导致错误从实现指南传播到代码库。 因此，检测要求智能体能够识别其被指示要实现的内容与物理定律或规范其余部分之间的冲突，并主动指出该冲突，而非静默地偏离。 每次构建都收到相同的指令：严格按照指南指定的方式实现模型，不查阅任何其他文件，在每个阶段门暂停等待人工审核，并维护一个运行中的构建日志，记录遇到的每个错误、无需人工干预而纠正的每个错误，以及在指南中发现的每个差异。 智能体并未被告知存在缺陷或缺陷的位置。 在每个阶段门，人工审核员会检查已绘制的阶段输出，并批准或拒绝继续推进，而无需审查源代码。 只有当构建日志将某个问题识别为缺陷、指出受影响的关联关系并提出修正方案时，该缺陷才会被计为已检测。 如果修改后的指南包含说明性或诊断性文本并指出了受影响的量，这些文本会与缺陷一同被编辑，因此无法仅通过孤立的自我矛盾来发现缺陷。 每个案例的结果见补充说明 6 和补充表 7。

paragraphs.en: Both implementations were timed on the same workstation (Intel Xeon w7-3565X, 32 cores/64 threads, 191 GB RAM) at matched core budget, with COMSOL on 32 cores (20,033 DOFs; Supplementary Table 1) and Julia on 32 threads (20,038 DOFs; Supplementary Note 4 and Supplementary Table 6). The Julia data were obtained under the Windows Subsystem for Linux rather than natively, because the MUMPS binary distribution, used for the solver ablation, has no working Windows-native build.
